content:
Apple is expanding the reach of watchOS 27.0.1 to more Apple Watch models today, following last week's initial rollout for the Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4. Here's what you need to know.

Apple Watch users can now install watchOS 27.0.1

Last week, Apple released watchOS 27.0.1 only for the Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4, addressing an issue that could cause some devices to unexpectedly restart.

Today, the company is pushing watchOS 27.0.1 to all other Apple Watch models compatible with watchOS 27, including:

  • Apple Watch SE 3
  • Apple Watch Series 9
  • Apple Watch Series 10
  • Apple Watch Series 11
  • Apple Watch Ultra 2
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3

Apple hasn't changed the release notes for watchOS 27.0.1, which still read as follows:

Also, the official build number released today is 24R365, the same as last week's for the Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4.

In addition to watchOS 27.0.1, Apple also rolled out iOS 27.0.1, iPadOS 27.0.1, visionOS 27.0.1, iOS 26.7.1, macOS 27.0.1 Golden Gate, macOS Tahoe 26.7.1, and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 today.

iOS 27.0.1 fixes an issue that could cause some iPhone 18 Pro models to restart when using Face ID, while the other updates include additional bug fixes and security improvements.

  • Apple Watch Ultra 4
  • AirPods Pro 3
  • AirPods 5
  • AirTag (2nd generation) — 4 pack
  • MacBook Neo
  • Logitech MX Master 4
